verdict.rationale: Insomnia organizations let users share collections and environments with colleagues (insomnia-docs-12). Projects can use Cloud Sync or Git Sync storage (insomnia-docs-32, insomnia-docs-22), with an in-app merge view for resolving conflicts (insomnia-docs-23), encrypted sync (insomnia-docs-34), unlimited contributors (insomnia-docs-42), and RBAC (insomnia-docs-11). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of team sync, detailed first-party docs on how Cloud Sync shared workspaces behave.
